Flag: a wide column that also carries an inline style child

Reading copy set across a column this wide asks the eye to travel a long way back to the start of every line, and after a few lines of it a reader starts to lose their place. The measure is what a designer sets with a max-width on the text block, and this block sets none at all, so every line runs the full width of the column it sits in from one edge to the other.

Flag: a wide column written with source indentation

Reading copy set across a column this wide asks the eye to travel a long way back to the start of every line, and after a few lines of it a reader starts to lose their place. The measure is what a designer sets with a max-width on the text block, and this block sets none at all, so every line runs the full width of the column it sits in from one edge to the other.

Pass: a 560px measure with an inline style child

A paragraph held to a comfortable measure wraps long before the eye has far to travel back, and this one keeps to about seventy characters a line.

Pass: a 560px measure with a hidden child and a script child

A paragraph held to a comfortable measure wraps long before the eye has far to travel back, with a long run of words that a script reveals later and that take up no part of any line until then, however many of them there are in the source of the page, and this one keeps to about seventy characters a line.

Pass: a 560px measure written with deep source indentation

A paragraph held to a comfortable measure wraps long before the eye has far to travel back, and this one keeps to about seventy characters a line from its first sentence to its last.

Pass: Devanagari prose on a 640px measure at 16px

राजस्थान के दक्षिणी भाग की अरावली पर्वतमाला के बीच स्थित यह प्राचीन मंदिर श्रद्धालुओं के लिए आस्था का प्रमुख केंद्र है और प्रतिवर्ष नवरात्रि के अवसर पर यहाँ विशाल मेले का आयोजन किया जाता है जिसमें दूर-दूर से भक्त आते हैं। इस क्षेत्र से बहने वाली माही नदी को पुराणों में पवित्र माना गया है और मंदिर की मूर्ति काले पत्थर से निर्मित है जिसकी अठारह भुजाएँ हैं।
